name: Anita Martinez
original_name: アニタ・マルティネス
source:
Affiliation: Elusion
Post: Head Chef
Birthplace: Mexico (Acapulco)

A cook who watches over the crew with her kind smile and delicious meals.
She's kind and always giving advice, but she doesn't go easy on those who leave leftovers.
